exposure: unrestricted oral fluids plus encouraged intravenous fluids
finding: Increased intravenous hydration does not decrease labor duration, oxytocin augmentation need, or affect mode of delivery in women with unrestricted oral fluid intake.
mod_finding: There was no difference in the normal delivery rate (93.3% vs 93.3%) or operative delivery rate (6.7% vs 6.7%) between the two groups.
